items.question: How many years do owners of existing residential houses in the UAE have to install fire detecting devices under the Hassantuk mandatory installation rule?
items.gold: Three years from the issuance of the resolution.
items.fact: Existing house owners get three years to install detectors

items.question: Who bears the cost of installing fire detecting devices in the homes of people with limited income under the UAE's Hassantuk mandatory installation rule?
items.fact: Federal and local governments pay for low-income homes' detectors
